text: The question of advertising on the Zoo Road Bridge was raised at the meeting of the Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo on February 22, 2018. After a review by Zoo staff, this report provides a recommendation that the Zoo Road Bridge over Meadowvale Road be designated as an approved bridge for banners for the purpose of advertising upcoming events and attractions for the Toronto Zoo.

The Board of Management of the Toronto Zoo: 1. Requested the City of Toronto to approve the Zoo Road Bridge over Meadowvale Road for northbound and southbound facing bridge banners for the sole use of the Toronto Zoo, and that the fees to the City and the two-week time limit for bridge banners be waived.
